categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Sun-Novo Pharmaceutical Research Co., Ltd. operates primarily as a Contract Research Organization (CRO) providing comprehensive drug research and development services. Its main segments include drug discovery, pharmacology and efficacy studies, pharmaceutical research, clinical trials (Phase I-IV), and bioanalysis services. The company also engages in innovative drug development, generic drug development, and consistency evaluation services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as Computer-Aided Drug Design (CADD), Artificial Intelligence-Driven Drug Design (AIDD), and proprietary platforms like iCVETide® for peptide drug discovery and BiMTtide® for peptide-drug conjugates (PDC). It has established platforms for controlled-release formulations, transdermal drug delivery systems (TDDS), and small nucleic acid drug delivery. The firm maintains GLP and GCP compliant laboratories and employs sophisticated pharmacokinetics/pharmacodynamics (PK/PD) and immunogenicity evaluation techniques.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Sun-Novo serves approximately 1,000 domestic pharmaceutical companies and research institutions, including large and medium-sized drug manufacturers. Its services cater to clients developing innovative drugs, improved new drugs, and generic drugs across multiple therapeutic areas such as oncology, cardiovascular, endocrine, respiratory, and rare diseases. The company also collaborates with biotech firms and academic institutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's operations are primarily based in China, with headquarters and major R&D facilities located in Beijing and subsidiaries across other Chinese cities including Chengdu, Nanjing, and Shanghai. While its current revenue and operations focus on the domestic market, it has strategic plans to expand internationally by selecting drug candidates for overseas development and patent protection.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sun-Novo operates mainly in the midstream segment of the pharmaceutical supply chain as a CRO, providing outsourced R&D services that support upstream drug discovery and downstream clinical development and regulatory approval. It does not engage in drug manufacturing or direct sales but collaborates closely with pharmaceutical manufacturers and biotech companies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes integrated 'preclinical + clinical' drug development services, focusing on innovation in peptides, long-acting microspheres, controlled-release formulations, local delivery, cell therapy, and nucleic acid drugs. It invests heavily in AI-driven drug discovery platforms and aims to build a global pipeline of proprietary innovative drugs. Strategic priorities include expanding clinical trial capabilities, enhancing technology platforms, and fostering international collaborations and patent protections.
categories.revenue_model: Sun-Novo generates revenue primarily through fee-for-service contracts with pharmaceutical clients, charging based on project milestones, progress, or deliverables in drug discovery, preclinical research, clinical trials, and bioanalysis. Additionally, it obtains revenue from equity participation and sales royalties through rights-sharing agreements on certain drug candidates. The company operates mainly on a direct sales model to pharmaceutical enterprises.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a competitive mid-sized domestic CRO with a strong integrated service platform in China. It faces competition from large multinational CROs like IQVIA and Covance, as well as leading Chinese CROs such as WuXi AppTec, Pharmaron, Tigermed, and Joinn. Sun-Novo differentiates itself through its focus on innovative drug platforms, AI integration, and comprehensive preclinical to clinical services.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Sun-Novo reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.078 billion, a 15.7% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 177.4 million, a slight decline of 3.98%. The company has steadily increased R&D investment, which accounted for 15.94% of revenue in 2024. It employs over 1,550 staff, with 84.7% in R&D roles, reflecting a growth trajectory focused on innovation and service expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sun-Novo offers a one-stop integrated drug R&D service platform combining preclinical and clinical research, supported by advanced AI-driven drug discovery technologies and proprietary platforms for peptides and controlled-release formulations. Its strong quality control, compliance with international standards, and extensive clinical trial network provide clients with efficient, high-quality, and customizable drug development solutions. The company’s strategic equity participation in drug candidates further aligns its interests with clients, enhancing long-term value creation.
